findings.title: Unqualified feature bytes receive future-write credit without a bounded usable-cache contract.
findings.evidence: A4096byte foreign_unclaimed.bin inside a registered feature-run directory, with no valid cache outputs, reduced remaining_required by12288bytes including its directories. The exact expected non-credit/rejection test is RED.
findings.effect: Full remaining feature writes can be understated even when no corresponding usable cache exists; a correctly named parent directory is insufficient to show those bytes replace future writes. This is resource accounting, not scientific acceptance.
findings.recommendation: Keep full feature_cap conservative until an externally accepted remaining-plan/role contract explicitly validates retained feature contributions; or enforce the full registered append-only role inventory/shape/context and failed-evidence accounting before granting any byte credit. Do not delete evidence or count compression/snapshots/reuse as credit.

findings.title: Statistic-output consumption is credited without binding the current input/job/static identity/full inventory.
findings.evidence: A valid generic CompactSink for the same directory job name but input_admission_sha256=b*64 instead of plan a*64 and inventory only unrelated.json reduced current-plan remaining writes by49152bytes. It has the same cap/sink implementation yet is not this selected-M job result.
findings.effect: An externally pinned30-job plan can receive budget credit for a foreign result namespace; the future real execute would derive a different identity token and reject that plan at line97, so the full matrix write bound was not actually covered.
findings.recommendation: Before credit, require canonical token derived from the saved static identity, current input SHA,exact job/schema/scope/static implementation inventory and complete declared D60/H37 inventory (and source/cache binding as required). Use a verified allocation contract, not scientific-result acceptance; otherwise conservatively grant zero credit.

findings.effect: Direct admission/permit bytes are rechecked, but unchanged reference fields can point to invalidated/revoked external proof bytes. Final completion can be published without the complete originally authorized proof chain still holding.

Rebind before source/cache loading,around each saved artifact and immediately before completion/return as appropriate. A changed reference must fail closed with no new complete; preserve staged/committed evidence.
